profile.headline: Sr Software Developer Engineer in Test | Accessibility | BECU | WAS Certified
profile.jobTitle: Sr Software Developer Engineer in Test
profile.summary:
I am a certified Web Accessibility Specialist and currently working as a Sr Software Developer Engineer in Test within the Accessibility team at BECU. 

I have 8 years experience in the accessibility world with over 10 years experience working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, SQL, and Git with working knowledge of WordPress and Laravel development.

Prior to making the switch to accessibilty advocacy, I was a front-end web developer and have an academic background in Political Science and International Relations. My career started in the non-profit/association space working on special projects and quickly realized that I excelled most when using code to make things more beautiful, efficient, and accessible.

I'm interested in collaboration, open-source, and focusing on making more accessible web experiences for all users.

Pronouns: he/him/his

positions.title: Sr Software Developer Engineer in Test
Web Accessibility Lead
positions.description:
- Lead accessibility strategy for ITHAKA's Product & Design including JSTOR, Artstor, Portico, & ITHAKA S&R
- Partner with participant and user support service teams in responding to requests about our current Section 508 and WCAG compliance 
- Conduct accessibility training for content creators, designers, front-end engineers, and quality assurance team members
- Perform accessibility audits as part of our VPAT/ACR authoring as well as along side product teams within the software delivery lifecycle
positions.insights: Skills: WCAG Compliance · Computer Technology · Communication

positions.title: Senior Accessibility Consultant
positions.description:
Industry Lead, Enterprise Financial Sector

- Accessibility lead for 15+ accounts that are on all points of the spectrum of the accessibility journey
- Facilitating agile transformations in accessibility
- Providing guidance during and after accessibility assessments and helping prioritize remediation efforts

positions.title: Accessibility Consultant
positions.description:
- Work with clients to assess which web pages and components to review 
- Perform audits through automatic and manual testing of WCAG 2.1 A & AA success criteria
- Deliver reports that prioritize which issues to address first
- Making the web a more accessible place for all

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
- Built and launched 30+ sites using a proprietary CMS with HTML/CSS/JS/PHP
- Worked collaboratively with designers and account managers
- Researched and developed company wide accessibility best practices
- Helped with the integration of an eCommerce platform (BigCommerce)
- Supported legacy clients with bug fixes and maintenance updates
positions.insights: Skills: WCAG Compliance · Computer Technology · Front-End Development

company.name: American Association of Colleges of Nursing (AACN)

positions.title: Student Services Coordinator
positions.description:
Provided technical expertise and high-level support to the NursingCAS, GNSA and Communications staff, assisted with the daily operations and growth of strategic initiatives, including dashboard development, member communication, marketing efforts, database management, and web content generation.

- Created and managed dynamic dashboards, user interface views, and reports for AACN leadership, internal staff, and external groups as needed
- Built and maintained the NursingCAS database and NursingCAS.org
- Produced and designed web-based resources and marketing to support growth and outreach for NursingCAS and GNSA using InDesign, Photoshop, and HTML/CSS/JavaScript
- Assisted with GNSA Webinars, including marketing, registration, and evaluation 
- Maintained student membership database and directory of GNSA Liaisons at all schools.
- Managed and updated social media presence for NursingCAS and GNSA.

positions.title: Student Services Assistant
positions.description:
Assisted the daily operation and growth of NursingCAS by developing printed and web based communications, participating in online web conferences with prospective schools and assisting with the on-boarding process for new schools, and help develop and maintain NursingCAS.org.

Helped with outreach and communications for the Graduate Nursing Student Association (GNSA), by designing marketing materials, hosting webinars, and posting relevant information through various social media channels. 

Served as back up to the IT Director, assist through tech support, on site and off site, with network and audio/video issues.

positions.title: Doctoral Advancement in Nursing Program Assistant
positions.description: Maintained the mentoring website, conducted survey analysis on students readiness to attend doctoral programs, assisted in the marketing campaign of the DAN Project, kept track of budgeting, and organized committee meetings.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
- Working with Education Industry faculty by preparing course literature and syllabus for the spring semester
- Participate in seminars with students
- Assisting Dean of Faculty with drafting the NDU’s Strategic Plan and Mission Statement for 2013.
- Support faculty and staff with research and administrative tasks and projects.
